Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Sickening
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 191, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 296
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 9,000 gp (lesser), 32,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that sicken affected creatures as though using the Sickening Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Sickening Spell; Cost 4,500 gp (lesser), 16,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater)
